chapter.verse: Zeisu Khazih’ sila leh sawltak keimah Simon Piter in, eite Pasian leh Honpa Zeisu Khazih’ dikna hangin kote thu-up bangin a manpha upna a ngah mite ka hong zasak hi.
Pasian leh i Topa Zeisu’ theihtel pilna hangin hehpihna thupha leh nopna in note tungah kicing takin om ta hen.
Tua mah bangin ama minthan’na leh ama dikna tawh hong sam Pasian’ theihtel pilna hangin, eite nuntakna leh Pasian lamah nopsakna tawh kipawl na khempeuh ama vangliatna siangtho a hong pia zo hi.

Tuate hangin zong a manpha a lian mahmah thuciamnate eite hong pia zo hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, hih thuciamnate suangin deihgawhna hangin hih leitungah a om kisiat gawpna tawh note in kipelhin, Pasian’ nuntakna tawh kizom mi na suah nading uh ahi hi.
Ahi hi. Tua thu hangin note in upna tungah hoihna, hoihna tungah lungpilna,
lungpilna tungah noptat khamna, noptatna khamna tungah thuakna, thuakna tungah Pasian biakna lamah nopsakna,
Pasian biakna lamah nopsakna tungah ki-unau itna, ki-unau itna tungah ki-itna hahkat mahmahin na koih thuap un.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, tua thupha teng note in nei-in na hauh uh leh, i Topa Zeisu Khazih’ theihtelna-ah thadah loh nading ahi zongin, a gah om lo mawkna ahih loh nading ahi zongin, hong bawlpha thei uh hi.
Tua gamtat pha a nei lo mi in mittaw a, a muhna tom a, ama mawhna luite sawp siangna thu a mangngilh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ute naute aw, note hong sapna leh hong teelna kipsak nadingin, nakpi-in hahkat zaw un. Tua bang na hih uh leh, na puk ngei kei ding uh hi.
Tua bang hangin eite Topa leh Honpa Zeisu Khazih’ tawntung Gam sung lut theihna thu note a kicingin hong kipia ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin na ngahsa uh thuman thutak note in thei-in tua thu-ah kip khin na hi uh zongin tua nate ngaihsunin note hong phawksak kik dingin ka om khol tawntung ding hi.
I Topa Zeisu Khazih in hong lah sa mah bangin a sawt loin ka pumpi nuntakna ka nutsiat ding thei ka hih ciangin,
hih pumpi nuntakna-ah ka om lai takin note hong phawksakin, kong hansuah ding kilawm ka sa hi.
Ahi hi. Ka sih khit ciangin note in hih thute na phawk tawntung nading uh ka hahkat ding hi.

Kote in i Topa Zeisu Khazih’ vangliatna ahi zongin, a hong paikikna thu ahi zongin, note kiangah kong gen uh ciangin pilna tawh kibawl tangthu zui loin, a thupitna leh a liatna mu-in teci ka hi uh hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, “Hihpa in ka lung hong damsak ka it ka Tapa hi,” ci-in Vanglian Bel sung pan tua Topa tungah aw khat hong tun’ ciangin, Pa Pasian kiang pan minthan’na leh liatna a ngah hi.
Kote in mual siangtho tungah Topa tawh ka omkhawm lai takun, van panin tua aw ka za uh hi.

Tua bang hangin kamsangte’ thugenna thu, eite adingin a kip zaw hi. Note lungsim sungah khuavakin, zingsol suak a, khua hong vak dongin tua thu, khuamialna-ah a tang meivak bangin ngaihsunin na belh dingun a kilawm hi.
Lai Siangtho-ah a om Pasian’ kamsangte’ thu in mi ut thu bangin a khiatna dawk lo hi ci-in a masa belin na thei un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian’ kamsangte’ thu in mi’ deih bangin hong tung ngei kei hi, Kha Siangtho hansuahna ngahin mite in Pasian kiang pan a gen sawn uh hi.
